title: Tenses
subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A Tense is the form of a verb that indicates the time of an action, event, or state.
definition.marathi: क्रिया कोणत्या काळात घडते (वर्तमान, भूत किंवा भविष्य), हे दर्शवणाऱ्या Verb च्या रूपाला Tense म्हणतात.

parts.title: Present Tenses

definition.english: Present Tense tells about present action, habit, routine, universal truth, scheduled event, current action, recently completed action, or action continuing from past till present.
definition.marathi: Present Tense वर्तमान क्रिया, सवय, दिनक्रम, सत्य, वेळापत्रक किंवा भूतकाळापासून सुरू असलेली क्रिया दर्शवतो.

tenseTypes.name: Simple Present Tense

definition.english: Used for habit, daily routine, universal truth, facts, permanent situations, newspaper headlines, and scheduled events.
definition.marathi: नेहमी होणारी क्रिया, सवय, सत्य, दिनक्रम किंवा कायमची गोष्ट दर्शवण्यासाठी वापरला जातो.

examples: The sun rises in the east.

rules.title: Third Person Singular : He/She/It/Any Singular Noun takes V1 + s/es.
rules.english: He/She/It/Any Singular Noun takes V1 + s/es.
rules.marathi: He/She/It किंवा Singular Noun नंतर V1+s/es वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: He play football.
wrongRight.right: He plays football.

rules.title: I / We / You / They : Use only V1
rules.english: Use only V1 with I, We, You, They.
rules.marathi: I/We/You/They नंतर फक्त V1 वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: They plays football.
wrongRight.right: They play football.

rules.title: Universal Truth : Always use Simple Present for universal truths.
rules.english: Always use Simple Present for universal truths.
rules.marathi: सार्वत्रिक सत्यासाठी नेहमी Simple Present वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: Earth is revolving around the Sun.
wrongRight.right: Earth revolves around the Sun.

rules.title: Habit / Routine : Daily activities use Simple Present.
rules.english: Daily activities use Simple Present.
rules.marathi: दैनंदिन क्रियांसाठी Simple Present वापरतात.
examples: I get up at 6 AM every day.

wrongRight.wrong: She is drinking coffee every morning.
wrongRight.right: She drinks coffee every morning.

rules.title: Newspaper Headlines : Simple Present
rules.english: Simple Present is used in newspaper headlines.
rules.marathi: वृत्तपत्राच्या मथळ्यांमध्ये Simple Present वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: PM is visiting France.
wrongRight.right: PM visits France.

wrongRight.wrong: India is winning the match.
wrongRight.right: India wins the match.

rules.title: Scheduled Events : Used for timetable, train, flight etc.
rules.english: Simple Present is used for fixed schedules such as timetables, trains, flights, buses, exams, and programs.
rules.marathi: वेळापत्रक, ट्रेन, फ्लाईट, बस, परीक्षा, कार्यक्रम अशा निश्चित वेळापत्रकासाठी Simple Present वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: The train will leave at 8 AM.
wrongRight.right: The train leaves at 8 AM.

wrongRight.wrong: The flight will arrive tomorrow morning.
wrongRight.right: The flight arrives tomorrow morning.

tenseTypes.sscPyqRule: After Every day, Always, Usually, Generally, Often, Never → Use Simple Present

definition.english: Action happening right now or around the present time.

rules.title: Be Verb Agreement : I → am, He/She/It → is, We/You/They → are.
rules.english: I → am, He/She/It → is, We/You/They → are.
rules.marathi: I→am, He/She/It→is, We/You/They→are.

wrongRight.wrong: They is playing.
wrongRight.right: They are playing.

rules.title: Temporary Action
rules.english: Used for temporary actions.
rules.marathi: तात्पुरत्या क्रियेसाठी वापरतात.
examples: I am living in Pune these days.
She is working from home this week.
They are staying with their relatives for a few days.

wrongRight.wrong: I live in Pune these days.
wrongRight.right: I am living in Pune these days.

rules.title: Changing Situation
rules.english: Used for a changing situation.
rules.marathi: बदलत्या परिस्थितीसाठी वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: The population increases rapidly nowadays.
wrongRight.right: The population is increasing rapidly nowadays.

rules.title: Fixed Near Future
rules.english: Used for personal arrangements in the near future.
rules.marathi: जवळच्या भविष्यातील ठरलेल्या नियोजनासाठी वापरतात.
examples: We are leaving for Delhi next week.
She is visiting her grandmother this evening.

wrongRight.wrong: I will meet him tomorrow. (already arranged)
wrongRight.right: I am meeting him tomorrow.

rules.title: Repeated Annoying Action
rules.english: Always + Present Continuous shows irritation.
rules.marathi: Always + Present Continuous त्रास/चीड दर्शवते.

wrongRight.wrong: He always shouts. (Habit)
wrongRight.right: He is always shouting. (Irritation)

definition.english: Action completed recently or whose result is connected with the present.
definition.marathi: आत्ताच पूर्ण झालेली किंवा वर्तमानाशी संबंध असलेली क्रिया.

rules.title: Has vs Have: He/She/It/Singular → Has; I/We/You/They/Plural → Have.
rules.english: He/She/It/Singular → Has; I/We/You/They/Plural → Have.
rules.marathi: He/She/It/Singular → Has; I/We/You/They/Plural → Have.

wrongRight.wrong: They has completed the work.
wrongRight.right: They have completed the work.

rules.title: Completed Action
rules.english: Used for a recently completed action whose result is connected with the present.
rules.marathi: आत्ताच पूर्ण झालेल्या आणि ज्याचा परिणाम वर्तमानाशी संबंधित आहे अशा क्रियेसाठी Present Perfect वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: I completed my homework just now.
wrongRight.right: I have completed my homework.

rules.title: Experience
rules.english: Used to describe life experiences without mentioning a specific past time.
rules.marathi: विशिष्ट वेळ न सांगता जीवनातील अनुभव दर्शवण्यासाठी Present Perfect वापरतात.
examples: She has never seen the Taj Mahal.
Have you ever travelled by air?

wrongRight.wrong: I have visited Delhi yesterday.
wrongRight.right: I visited Delhi yesterday.

rules.title: Yet: used only in negative and interrogative sentences.
rules.english: Yet is used only in negative and interrogative sentences.
rules.marathi: Yet फक्त Negative आणि Interrogative वाक्यांमध्ये वापरतात.
examples: I haven't finished my work yet.

wrongRight.wrong: I have yet finished my work.
wrongRight.right: I haven't finished my work yet.

rules.title: Already
rules.english: Already is generally used in affirmative sentences to show an action happened earlier than expected.
rules.marathi: Already मुख्यतः Positive वाक्यांमध्ये अपेक्षेपेक्षा आधी पूर्ण झालेली क्रिया दर्शवण्यासाठी वापरतात.
examples: They have already reached the station.

wrongRight.wrong: I haven't already finished the work.
wrongRight.right: I haven't finished the work yet.

rules.title: Since - Point of Time / For - period of time:
rules.english: Since is used with a point of time, and For is used with a period of time. They are commonly used with Present Perfect Continuous, but may also be used with Present Perfect.
rules.marathi: Since वेळेच्या बिंदूसाठी (Point of Time) आणि For कालावधीसाठी (Period of Time) वापरतात. हे सामान्यतः Present Perfect Continuous सोबत येतात, परंतु Present Perfect सोबतही वापरले जाऊ शकतात.
examples: I have lived in Pune for five years.
He has been studying for three hours.
They have been living here since January.

wrongRight.wrong: I have been living here since five years.
wrongRight.right: I have been living here for five years.

wrongRight.wrong: She has worked here for 2020.
wrongRight.right: She has worked here since 2020.

sscPyqTrap2.right: I have just completed my homework.

tenseTypes.name: Present Perfect Continuous Tense

definition.english: Action started in the past and is still continuing.
definition.marathi: भूतकाळात सुरू झालेली आणि अजूनही सुरू असलेली क्रिया.

examples: I have been studying for three hours.
She has been living here since 2020.

rules.title: Since = Point of Time
rules.english: Since is used with a point of time (2019, Monday, Morning, 5 PM, January, Childhood).
rules.marathi: Since वेळेच्या बिंदूसाठी वापरतात.
examples: She has been studying since Monday.

wrongRight.wrong: She has been studying for Monday.
wrongRight.right: She has been studying since Monday.

rules.title: For = Period of Time
rules.english: For is used with a period of time (2 hours, 5 years, 3 months, 10 days, Long time).
rules.marathi: For कालावधीसाठी वापरतात.
examples: He has been waiting for two hours.
They have been working for five years.

wrongRight.wrong: He has been waiting since two hours.
wrongRight.right: He has been waiting for two hours.

rules.title: Action Must Continue
rules.english: The action must still continue.
rules.marathi: क्रिया अजूनही सुरू असणे आवश्यक.
examples: I have been working here since 2023.
She has been studying for three hours.
They have been living in Pune since 2020.

wrongRight.wrong: I have been working here since 2023, but I left the job last year.
wrongRight.right: I worked here from 2023 to last year.

rules.title: Duration + Present
rules.english: Duration expressions indicate Present Perfect Continuous.
rules.marathi: कालावधी दर्शवणारे शब्द Present Perfect Continuous दर्शवतात.
examples: I have been waiting for two hours.
She has been teaching since morning.
They have been playing all day.

wrongRight.wrong: I am waiting for two hours.
wrongRight.right: I have been waiting for two hours.

wrongRight.wrong: She is teaching since morning.
wrongRight.right: She has been teaching since morning.

goldenRevision: has/have been + V-ing → Started in Past & Continuing

pyqTraps.wrong: She has been living here for Monday.
pyqTraps.right: She has been living here since Monday.

examStrategy.label: Tier-1
examStrategy.text: Learn all 4 Present Tense structures. Memorize Since vs For. Practice 40–50 Present Tense PYQs.

examStrategy.label: Tier-2
examStrategy.text: Focus on Sentence Improvement. Master Present Perfect vs Simple Past. Revise State Verbs (Part 4).

parts.finalVerdict: These notes cover nearly 95–100% of the Present Tense syllabus asked in SSC CGL Tier-1 & Tier-2, combining standard grammar rules with common SSC PYQ patterns in a compact revision format.

parts.title: Past Tenses

definition.english: Past Tense is used to describe an action that happened or was completed in the past.
definition.marathi: भूतकाळात घडलेली किंवा पूर्ण झालेली क्रिया दर्शवण्यासाठी Past Tense वापरला जातो.

tenseTypes.name: Simple Past Tense

definition.english: Used for an action completed in the past.

rules.title: Use V2 in Affirmative
rules.english: Always use V2 in affirmative sentence.
rules.marathi: Affirmative वाक्यात नेहमी V2 वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: He write a letter.
wrongRight.right: He wrote a letter.

rules.title: After Did, use V1
rules.english: V1 is used after Did.
rules.marathi: Did नंतर V1 वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: Did you went?
wrongRight.right: Did you go?

rules.title: Negative uses V1
rules.english: Negative sentences also use V1.
rules.marathi: Negative वाक्यातही V1 वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: He did not came.
wrongRight.right: He did not come.

rules.title: Finished Action
rules.english: Used for a finished action in the past.
rules.marathi: भूतकाळातील पूर्ण झालेल्या क्रियेसाठी वापरतात.
examples: She finished her homework last night.

wrongRight.wrong: I have met him yesterday.
wrongRight.right: I met him yesterday.

tenseTypes.sscPyqRule: Yesterday, Ago, Last, Previous → Use Simple Past

definition.english: An action that was going on at a particular time in the past.
definition.marathi: भूतकाळातील एका विशिष्ट वेळी सुरू असलेली क्रिया.

rules.title: Was vs Were
rules.english: I/He/She/It/Singular → Was; We/You/They/Plural → Were.
rules.marathi: I/He/She/It/Singular → Was; We/You/They/Plural → Were.

wrongRight.wrong: They was studying.
wrongRight.right: They were studying.

rules.title: Interrupted Action
rules.english: Past Continuous + Simple Past shows an interrupted action.
rules.marathi: Past Continuous + Simple Past मध्ये चालू असलेली क्रिया दुसऱ्या क्रियेमुळे थांबते.
examples: I was sleeping when he called.
She was cooking when the lights went out.

wrongRight.wrong: I slept when he called.
wrongRight.right: I was sleeping when he called.

rules.title: Two Simultaneous Actions
rules.english: Past Continuous + Past Continuous shows two actions happening together.
rules.marathi: Past Continuous + Past Continuous दोन एकाच वेळी सुरू असलेल्या क्रिया दर्शवते.
examples: While I was reading, she was cooking.
They were talking while we were watching TV.

wrongRight.wrong: While I read, she was cooking.
wrongRight.right: While I was reading, she was cooking.

rules.title: Specific Past Time
rules.english: Used with a specific past time.
rules.marathi: भूतकाळातील विशिष्ट वेळेला चालू असलेली क्रिया दर्शवण्यासाठी वापरतात.
examples: At 8 PM yesterday, I was studying.
At this time last year, we were travelling.

wrongRight.wrong: At 8 PM yesterday, I studied.
wrongRight.right: At 8 PM yesterday, I was studying.

sscTrap.right: When he came, I was studying.

tenseTypes.name: Past Perfect Tense

definition.english: An action completed before another action in the past.
definition.marathi: भूतकाळातील दुसऱ्या क्रियेपूर्वी पूर्ण झालेली क्रिया.

examples: I had finished my work before he arrived.
She had left before I reached.

rules.title: Comes Before Another Past Action
rules.english: Past Perfect is used for the action that happened before another action in the past.
rules.marathi: भूतकाळातील दोन क्रियांपैकी आधी घडलेल्या क्रियेसाठी Past Perfect वापरतात.
examples: I had finished my homework before my friends arrived.
She had left before I reached the station.

wrongRight.wrong: I finished my homework before my friends arrived.
wrongRight.right: I had finished my homework before my friends arrived.

rules.title: Past Perfect + Simple Past
rules.english: Past Perfect is generally used with Simple Past to show the order of two past actions.
rules.marathi: दोन भूतकाळातील क्रियांचा क्रम दाखवण्यासाठी Past Perfect सोबत Simple Past वापरतात.
examples: The train had left before we reached.
The teacher had started the class before the students entered.

wrongRight.wrong: The train left before we reached.
wrongRight.right: The train had left before we reached.

rules.title: Sequence
rules.english: Earlier Action → Had + V3; Later Action → V2.
rules.marathi: आधीची क्रिया → Had + V3; नंतरची क्रिया → V2.
examples: I had eaten before he arrived.
She had gone home before it rained.
They had completed the project before the deadline ended.
He arrived after I had eaten.
It rained after she had gone home.
The deadline ended after they had completed the project.

wrongRight.wrong: She went home before it rained.
wrongRight.right: She had gone home before it rained.

wrongRight.wrong: He arrived after I ate.
wrongRight.right: He arrived after I had eaten.

rules.title: Signal Words
rules.english: Words like Before, After, By the time, When, Already often indicate the use of Past Perfect.
rules.marathi: Before, After, By the time, When, Already हे शब्द अनेकदा Past Perfect दर्शवतात.
examples: By the time I reached, he had gone.
After she had finished her work, she went home.
When we arrived, the movie had already started.

wrongRight.wrong: When we arrived, the movie already started.
wrongRight.right: When we arrived, the movie had already started.

tenseTypes.name: Past Perfect Continuous Tense

definition.english: Action continued for some time before another action in the past.
definition.marathi: भूतकाळातील दुसऱ्या क्रियेपूर्वी काही काळ चालू असलेली क्रिया.

examples: I had been waiting for two hours before the bus arrived.
She had been working since morning before she became ill.

rules.title: Had been + V-ing
rules.english: Structure uses had been + V-ing.
rules.marathi: रचना Had been + V-ing अशी असते.
examples: He had been studying for three hours.
They had been waiting since morning.
She had been working all day.

wrongRight.wrong: He had been study for three hours.
wrongRight.right: He had been studying for three hours.

wrongRight.wrong: They had been wait since morning.
wrongRight.right: They had been waiting since morning.

rules.title: Duration Before Past Event
rules.english: Shows duration before another past event.
rules.marathi: दुसऱ्या भूतकाळातील घटनेपूर्वी किती काळ क्रिया सुरू होती हे दर्शवते.
examples: I had been working for five years before I resigned.
She had been living there since 2015 before she moved.
They had been playing for two hours before it started raining.

wrongRight.wrong: I worked for five years before I resigned.
wrongRight.right: I had been working for five years before I resigned.

wrongRight.wrong: They were playing for two hours before it started raining.
wrongRight.right: They had been playing for two hours before it started raining.

rules.title: Since / For
rules.english: Uses Since for a point of time and For for a period of time.
rules.marathi: Since वेळेच्या बिंदूसाठी (Point of Time) आणि For कालावधीसाठी (Period of Time) वापरतात.
examples: He had been waiting since 8 AM.
She had been studying for three hours.
They had been living there since 2018.
I had been working for ten years before retirement.

wrongRight.wrong: He had been waiting for 8 AM.
wrongRight.right: He had been waiting since 8 AM.

wrongRight.wrong: She had been studying since three hours.
wrongRight.right: She had been studying for three hours.

usedTo.definition: Past Habit that no longer happens now.

examples: Every evening my grandfather would tell stories.
We would play in the garden.
would.difference: Used To → Habit + State; Would → Repeated Action only.

wrongRight.wrong: I would live in Pune.
wrongRight.right: I used to live in Pune.

goldenRevision: had been + V-ing → Duration Before Past Action

pyqTraps.right: When I reached, he had left.
I used to live in Delhi.

examStrategy.label: Tier-1
examStrategy.text: Learn all 4 Past Tense structures. Master Did + V1. Understand Past Perfect sequence. Practice 40–50 Past Tense PYQs.

examStrategy.label: Tier-2
examStrategy.text: Focus on Past Perfect vs Simple Past, Used To vs Would, Since vs Ago, Sentence Improvement.

parts.finalVerdict: These notes cover nearly 95–100% of the Past Tense syllabus asked in SSC CGL Tier-1 & Tier-2, including structures, error patterns, sequence rules, Used To, Would, and Since/Ago.

parts.title: Future Tenses

definition.english: Future Tense is used to describe an action that will happen in the future.
definition.marathi: भविष्यात घडणारी किंवा घडणार असलेली क्रिया दर्शवण्यासाठी Future Tense वापरला जातो.

tenseTypes.name: Simple Future Tense

definition.english: Used for an action that will happen in the future.

rules.title: Use V1 after Will
rules.english: V1 is always used after 'Will'.
rules.marathi: Will नंतर नेहमी Verb चे पहिले रूप (V1) वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: He will goes to Delhi.
wrongRight.right: He will go to Delhi.

wrongRight.wrong: She will helped me.
wrongRight.right: She will help me.

rules.title: Future Prediction
rules.english: Simple Future is used to make predictions about the future.
rules.marathi: भविष्यात काय होईल याचा अंदाज व्यक्त करण्यासाठी Simple Future वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: It rains tomorrow.
wrongRight.right: It will rain tomorrow.

wrongRight.wrong: India wins the match tomorrow.
wrongRight.right: India will win the match tomorrow.

rules.title: Promise / Decision
rules.english: Will is used for promises, offers, and decisions.
rules.marathi: वचन, ऑफर किंवा निर्णय व्यक्त करण्यासाठी Will वापरतात.
examples: I will help you with your homework.
We will never forget your kindness.

wrongRight.wrong: I always support you tomorrow.
wrongRight.right: I will always support you.

wrongRight.wrong: We are support you.
wrongRight.right: We will support you.

rules.title: Instant Decision
rules.english: Will is used for decisions made at the moment of speaking.
rules.marathi: बोलत असताना तात्काळ घेतलेल्या निर्णयासाठी Will वापरतात.
examples: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
I am thirsty. I will get some water.
Someone is at the door. I will open it.

wrongRight.wrong: The phone is ringing. I answer it.
wrongRight.right: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.

wrongRight.wrong: Someone is at the door. I am opening it.
wrongRight.right: Someone is at the door. I will open it.

tenseTypes.sscPyqRule: Tomorrow, Next, Soon, Later → Use Simple Future

tenseTypes.name: Future Continuous Tense

definition.english: Action that will be in progress at a particular time in the future.
definition.marathi: भविष्यातील एका विशिष्ट वेळी सुरू असलेली क्रिया.

examples: I will be studying at 10 PM.

rules.title: Ongoing Future Action
rules.english: Shows an action that will be in progress at a particular time in the future.
rules.marathi: भविष्यातील एका विशिष्ट वेळी सुरू असलेली क्रिया दर्शवते.
examples: I will be studying at 10 PM.
She will be sleeping when you call.

wrongRight.wrong: I will studying at 10 PM.
wrongRight.right: I will be studying at 10 PM.

wrongRight.wrong: They will be travel tomorrow.
wrongRight.right: They will be travelling tomorrow.

rules.title: Specific Future Time
rules.english: Used for an action that will be happening at a specific future time.
rules.marathi: भविष्यातील विशिष्ट वेळेस सुरू असणारी क्रिया दर्शवण्यासाठी वापरतात.
examples: At 8 PM, I will be watching TV.
This time tomorrow, we will be flying to Delhi.
At noon, she will be attending a meeting.

wrongRight.wrong: At 8 PM, I will watch TV.
wrongRight.right: At 8 PM, I will be watching TV.

wrongRight.wrong: This time tomorrow, we will fly to Delhi.
wrongRight.right: This time tomorrow, we will be flying to Delhi.

rules.title: Polite Inquiry
rules.english: Future Continuous is used to make polite inquiries about someone's plans.
rules.marathi: एखाद्याच्या नियोजनाबद्दल नम्रपणे विचारण्यासाठी Future Continuous वापरतात.
examples: Will you be joining us tomorrow?
Will you be using your car this evening?
Will she be attending the meeting?

wrongRight.wrong: Will you join us tomorrow?
wrongRight.right: Will you be joining us tomorrow?

wrongRight.wrong: Will she attend the meeting?
wrongRight.right: Will she be attending the meeting?

tenseTypes.name: Future Perfect Tense

definition.english: Action that will be completed before a particular time in the future.
definition.marathi: भविष्यातील एका विशिष्ट वेळेपूर्वी पूर्ण झालेली क्रिया.

examples: I will have finished the work by evening.
She will have reached home before 8 PM.

rules.title: Completed Future Action
rules.english: Shows a completed future action.
rules.marathi: भविष्यातील पूर्ण झालेली क्रिया दर्शवते.
examples: She will have completed the project by Friday.
I will have reached home by 8 PM.

rules.title: Future Deadline
rules.english: Used for a future deadline.
rules.marathi: भविष्यातील अंतिम मुदतीसाठी वापरतात.
examples: They will have completed the project by Friday.

tenseTypes.name: Future Perfect Continuous Tense

definition.english: Action that will continue up to a point in the future.
definition.marathi: भविष्यातील एका वेळेपर्यंत चालू राहणारी क्रिया.

structure.positive: Subject + will have been + V-ing + Since/For
structure.negative: Subject + will not have been + V-ing

examples: By next month, I will have been working here for five years.
Next June, she will have been teaching for ten years.

rules.title: Duration Till Future
rules.english: Shows the duration of an action up to a particular point in the future.
rules.marathi: भविष्यातील एका विशिष्ट वेळेपर्यंत क्रिया किती काळ चालू असेल हे दर्शवते.
examples: By next year, I will have been working here for five years.
She will have been teaching for ten years by June.
By 8 PM, they will have been travelling for twelve hours.

wrongRight.wrong: By next year, I will have worked here for five years.
wrongRight.right: By next year, I will have been working here for five years.

wrongRight.wrong: By 8 PM, they will have been travel for twelve hours.
wrongRight.right: By 8 PM, they will have been travelling for twelve hours.

rules.title: Since / For
rules.english: Use Since for a point of time and For for a period of time.
rules.marathi: Since वेळेच्या बिंदूसाठी (Point of Time) आणि For कालावधीसाठी (Period of Time) वापरतात.
examples: By next month, I will have been living here since 2020.
By December, she will have been working for five years.
Next week, they will have been studying for three months.

wrongRight.wrong: She will have been working since five years.
wrongRight.right: She will have been working for five years.

wrongRight.wrong: I will have been living here for 2020.
wrongRight.right: I will have been living here since 2020.

rules.title: Sentence Improvement
rules.english: Future Perfect Continuous is commonly tested in Sentence Improvement and Error Spotting questions.
rules.marathi: Future Perfect Continuous प्रामुख्याने Sentence Improvement आणि Error Spotting मध्ये विचारला जातो.
examples: By next July, I will have been preparing for the SSC CGL exam for one year.
By tomorrow morning, she will have been waiting for six hours.
By 2028, they will have been running this company for twenty years.

wrongRight.wrong: By next July, I will have preparing for one year.
wrongRight.right: By next July, I will have been preparing for one year.

wrongRight.wrong: By tomorrow morning, she will have been waited for six hours.
wrongRight.right: By tomorrow morning, she will have been waiting for six hours.

shall.usage: Traditionally used with I, We. Nowadays Will is accepted for all subjects.

goingTo.definition: Used for planned action, strong prediction, and visible evidence.
examples: I am going to buy a new phone.

futureTimeClauses.rule: Use Simple Present, not Future, after these connectors.
examples: I will call you when I reach home.
We will start after he comes.

wrongRight.wrong: I will call you when I will reach home.
wrongRight.right: I will call you when I reach home.

examples: If you study, you will pass.

wrongRight.wrong: If you will study, you will pass.
wrongRight.right: If you study, you will pass.

goldenRevision: will be + V-ing → Future Ongoing Action
will have + V3 → Future Completed Action
will have been + V-ing → Future Duration

pyqTraps.wrong: I am going buy a car.
pyqTraps.right: I am going to buy a car.

pyqTraps.wrong: I will call you when I will arrive.
pyqTraps.right: I will call you when I arrive.

pyqTraps.wrong: If you will work hard, you will succeed.
pyqTraps.right: If you work hard, you will succeed.

pyqTraps.wrong: She will have been work here for five years.
pyqTraps.right: She will have been working here for five years.

examStrategy.label: Tier-1
examStrategy.text: Memorize all 4 Future Tense structures. Learn Will vs Going To. Practice Future Time Clauses. Solve 40–50 PYQs.

examStrategy.label: Tier-2
examStrategy.text: Focus on Future Perfect, Future Perfect Continuous, If Clauses, Sentence Improvement, Error Spotting.

parts.finalVerdict: These notes cover nearly 95–100% of the Future Tense syllabus asked in SSC CGL Tier-1 & Tier-2, including Will vs Shall, Will vs Going To, Future Time Clauses, First Conditional, and common PYQ traps.

parts.title: Advanced Tense Rules + SSC PYQ Tricks

definition.english: The verb in one clause depends on the tense of the other clause.
definition.marathi: एका Clause मधील Tense दुसऱ्या Clause च्या Tense नुसार बदलतो.

rules.title: Present → Present
rules.english: When the reporting verb is in Present, the reported verb stays in Present.
rules.marathi: Reporting Verb Present असल्यास Reported Verb ही Present राहते.
examples: He says that he is busy.

rules.title: Past → Past
rules.english: When the reporting verb is in Past, the reported verb also changes to Past.
rules.marathi: Reporting Verb Past असल्यास Reported Verb ही Past होते.
examples: He said that he was busy.

rules.title: Universal Truth Never Changes
rules.english: A universal truth never changes tense.
rules.marathi: सार्वत्रिक सत्याचा Tense कधीही बदलत नाही.
examples: Teacher said that the Earth revolves around the Sun.

wrongRight.wrong: Teacher said that the Earth revolved around the Sun.
wrongRight.right: Teacher said that the Earth revolves around the Sun.

rules.title: Historical Fact Never Changes
rules.english: A historical fact never changes tense.
rules.marathi: ऐतिहासिक सत्याचा Tense कधीही बदलत नाही.
examples: He said that Shivaji was a great king.

sscTrap.wrong: He said that the Sun rose in the east.
sscTrap.right: He said that the Sun rises in the east.

definition.english: These verbs generally do not take Continuous Tense.
definition.marathi: ही Verbs सामान्यतः Continuous Tense मध्ये वापरली जात नाहीत.

wrongRight.wrong: I am knowing him.
wrongRight.right: I know him.

wrongRight.wrong: She is liking tea.
wrongRight.right: She likes tea.

wrongRight.wrong: I am understanding.
wrongRight.right: I understand your problem.

examples: If you heat water, it boils.
If you study, you will pass.
If I were rich, I would help everyone.

conditionalSentences.formula: If + had + V3, would have + V3
examples: If he had studied, he would have passed.
If I had worked harder, I would be rich now.

wrongRight.wrong: If you will come...
wrongRight.right: If you come...

wrongRight.wrong: Did he went?
wrongRight.right: Did he go?

wrongRight.wrong: Does he plays?
wrongRight.right: Does he play?

wrongRight.wrong: Will he comes?
wrongRight.right: Will he come?

importantSscRules.title: After Modal Verbs, use V1
importantSscRules.english: can, may, must, should, could, might, would

wrongRight.wrong: He can swims.
wrongRight.right: He can swim.

pyqTraps.wrong: I will call you when I will reach.
pyqTraps.right: I will call you when I reach.

pyqTraps.wrong: The Earth revolved around the Sun.
pyqTraps.right: The Earth revolves around the Sun.

structures: has/have been + V-ing → Present Perfect Continuous
had been + V-ing → Past Perfect Continuous
will have been + V-ing → Future Perfect Continuous

examStrategy.label: Tier-1
examStrategy.text: Learn 12 tense structures by heart. Memorize signal words. Revise Golden Revision Page daily. Solve 120–150 Tense PYQs.

examStrategy.label: Tier-2
examStrategy.text: Focus on Error Spotting, Sentence Improvement, Fill in the Blanks, Cloze Test, Para Completion, Mixed Tense Questions.

parts.finalVerdict: These four parts together cover nearly 95–100% of the Tenses syllabus asked in SSC CGL Tier-1 & Tier-2, including all 12 Tenses, Sequence of Tenses, State Verbs, Conditional Sentences, Signal Words, and Common PYQ Traps. Read → Understand → Revise → Solve 120–150 PYQs → Re-revise will give a strong command over Tenses for SSC CGL English.
